info.title: Synap by Linkrra — open-model AI, paid per call
info.description: OpenAI-compatible inference for agents. Pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana or Solana—no account or API key. Dedicated GPUs, streaming responses, model-level pricing, vision, coding, and speech.

post.summary: LLM chat completions: OpenAI-compatible inference API (gpt-oss-20b, Gemma 4 26B, Qwen3 30B, Qwen3 Coder 30B, Qwen3 VL 30B). Pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana or Solana via x402, no account, no API key. From $0.001 per call.

model.description: "auto" (cheapest fit) or a concrete model id from GET /v1/models

max_tokens.description: Capped at 4096 (maximum output token limit); ask for less and the quote is priced for less

200.description: chat.completion object with usage and payment receipt (tx hash).

402.description: x402 v2 PaymentRequired: base64 in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and the same JSON in the body, priced for this exact request.

post.description: Cheap LLM inference for agent loops: one OpenAI-compatible chat completion per paid call. Send model "auto" (cheapest fit) or a model id from GET /v1/models. Price is quoted for this exact request: minimum $0.001, usage-priced per token above that. Streaming supported. Unknown model names get a 402 carrying suggested_model with its own accepts[] (suggestion only, never substituted).

post.summary: Buy prepaid inference credits with one x402 payment; the paying wallet is the account. Minimum top-up $1.00 (max $1000); below $1 is rejected.

200.description: Credits added; balance and tx hash returned.

post.summary: Text-to-speech WAV clip, paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). Hebrew gets automatic nikud. Minimum charge $0.01 per call; character-based price above it.

402.description: x402 v2 PaymentRequired challenge priced for this text.
